class.name: SteamDiagnosticMessage
class.brief_description: One Steam SDK diagnostic from a capture batch.
class.description: Each message records the SDK severity and a fixed description suitable for a developer console or log. The description is selected by severity, so the original SDK payload stays private.

method.name: get_severity
method.description: Returns the Steam SDK severity number. Steam uses [code]0[/code] for an informational message and [code]1[/code] for a warning.

method.name: get_text
method.description: Returns the fixed framework description for the severity. Future SDK severity codes use a generic diagnostic description.

members.member: Read-only Steam SDK severity number. Use it to select how a developer console presents the message.
Read-only description suitable for displaying or logging the diagnostic.
